name: Hides for the Forsaken
summary: In Tirisfal, the Forsaken gather animal skins to mend their ruined flesh. Shelene Rhobart asks you to bring darkhound hides, duskbat wing membranes, and murloc skin.

sections.title: The Price of Undeath
sections.body: Forsaken flesh cannot heal on its own. A wound leaves a rotting gap, and the body cannot close it through natural means. To keep their forms intact, the Forsaken stitch living tissue over their injuries and keep their corpses working.

sections.title: Specialized Materials
sections.body: Different materials mend different parts of the body. Thick darkhound hide suits broad repairs that need to hold firm. Duskbat wing membranes are thin and pliable, covering faces and fingers without making them stiff. Vile Fin murloc skin lines inner membranes and sensitive places such as cheeks and mouths.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken need animal skins?
faq.answer: Forsaken skin cannot heal or grow back after an injury. They harvest skins and membranes from living creatures to cover wounds and slow the decay.
Shelene Rhobart is a Forsaken leatherworker in Tirisfal Glades. She gathers hides and other materials so the wounded can mend their rotting forms.

faq.q: Why are duskbat wing membranes specifically needed?
faq.answer: Duskbat wing membranes are thin and supple. They cover delicate places such as faces and fingers without making the skin too thick or stiff.

faq.q: What is murloc skin used for?
faq.answer: Vile Fin murloc skin lines inner membranes and delicate surfaces, including the inside of cheeks and mouths.
Darkhounds, duskbats, and Vile Fin murlocs roam Tirisfal Glades. Darkhounds and duskbats haunt the woods and roadsides, while Vile Fin murlocs gather along the northern coast and inland waterways.

faq.q: Is using animal hides common for the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Yes. The Forsaken rely on animal tissue and scavenged remains to keep going. Without replacement flesh and hides, wounds can leave bones, organs, and muscles exposed.

angles.text: As an undead, you face the burdens of the Forsaken condition: keeping your body intact takes constant work and scavenged grafts, not natural healing.
As a tailor, you can use your stitching to bind beast membranes to decaying bodies as well as to make garments.
